purpose: Install, catalog, and make available external GitHub repositories and skills into the OpenClaw workspace. Provides a curated library of 26 installed repos (AI agents, trading tools, Claude skills) available for integration and adaptation.
model_policy: No AI needed for intake; manual or scripted git clone
startup: On-demand via clawhub or manual git clone
validation: PASS: 26 repos installed, intake dir available
approval_gates: Nathan approval for installing private/paid repos
rollback: Remove repo dir from installed/; re-clone from source if needed
kpi: Repos available / repos actively used in production
